title: Rank-weighted forecast turnover conditional on Top20 set overlap
hypothesis: Among successive prior-only APP SONAR Top20 forecasts with the same set-overlap state, the mean rank displacement of retained numbers may contain incremental information about the next target's Top20 hit-count distribution.

estimand.target: H_t = |Top20_t intersect D_t|, where Top20_t is computed only from draws strictly before target t.
estimand.previous_forecast: B_t = Top20(sonarAnalogCore(draws[0:t-1])); both are available before D_t.
estimand.mean_rank_displacement: d_t = mean_{n in A_t intersect B_t}(|rank_A(n)-rank_B(n)|/19); if m_t=0, d_t=1.

models.bins: All overlap and displacement thresholds are fixed here; no tuning or threshold selection on Validation or Blind OOS.
models.update_order: Score target using prior state counts; only after scoring update M1 and M2 counts with the target outcome.

sample.split_rule: Chronological 60%/20%/remainder over 3,203 targets after the 201-draw prefix needed to construct current and previous forecasts.

endpoints: Multiclass Brier score for H_t over k=0..5

inference.method: One-sided paired block sign-flip on per-target loss gains; positive gain means M2 improves.
inference.bootstrap: Circular moving-block bootstrap, 10,000 replicates, block length 20, percentile 95% interval.
inference.multiple_testing: Holm across four primary endpoints: Brier and log-loss for M2 versus M1 and M2 versus M0.

leakage_controls: Pin canonical archive, APP data and exact committed scorer blob SHA.
For target index t, compute current Top20 from draws[0:t] and previous Top20 from draws[0:t-1]; neither includes target t.
Update overlap-state and joint-state outcome counts only after target scoring.
Check every conditional probability vector sums to one within 1e-12.
Mutate target and future suffix at nine fixed targets; both forecast prefixes and rank-state features must remain identical.
Verify APP modelDraws exactly matches canonical CSV row-by-row.
Replay complete ledger, report, freeze and manifest deterministically.
guardrails: Research only; no production scorer or existing forecast changes.
No Q60 gate edits and no reconstructed historical freezes.
The Q121 freeze is separate and is not a Q60 paired target.
Historical Blind OOS is not a virgin holdout after prior SONAR exploration.
No automatic merge or engine promotion.
decision_rule: Retain M2 only as an exploratory diagnostic if it improves both primary loss metrics on Blind OOS and the Holm-adjusted one-sided tests support improvement; otherwise record a null/negative result. No production promotion.
